repos_data.description: Open-source PR gate for Python, TS/JS, Java, and Go. Stop merging dead code, secrets, security flows, and AI-code regressions.
AI writes. SPARDA proves. A deterministic, offline gate that catches when an AI edit removes a guard, exposes a route, or breaks an invariant — no API key, right in the agent edit loop.

Triage for AI-generated code review: grades each changed diff line green/yellow/orange by impact, so reviewers spend attention where it matters. High-signal, low-noise (0 false blocks), deterministic — in your coding agent (MCP), editor (VS Code), and CLI/CI.
Strict AI code reviewer MCP server powered by Groq
